tasks.title: Create internal/repomap package with Build function, walk, outline, rendering and budget reduction
steps: Create internal/repomap/ directory with repomap.go and repomap_test.go.

Write TS-14-1 through TS-14-10 in repomap_test.go. Each test creates a temp directory workspace with fixture files (Go source files with known declarations), calls repomap.Build, and asserts the documented behaviour. Use tools.NewWorkspace to create workspaces. For TS-14-3, create a .gitignore and a .hidden directory. For TS-14-6, create a file that causes outline.File to error (e.g. invalid syntax). For TS-14-10, call Build twice with identical args and assert byte-identical output across multiple budgets.
Confirm all tests fail.
Implement Build(ctx context.Context, ws *tools.Workspace, budget int, inputPaths []string) (string, error). When budget==0, return '', nil immediately.
Implement the walk: delegate to tools.Walk to collect all file paths, respecting ignore rules and hidden-entry exclusion.

Implement outline extraction: for each walked source file, call outline.File to get declarations. If outline.File errors for a file, include the file path without declarations and continue (do not fail the build).
Implement sorting: files by path, declarations within a file exported-first then by line number.

Implement rendering: directories with trailing '/', files indented two spaces, declarations on the same line separated by ' · ' showing kind name and L-prefixed line number. Collapsed directories as 'dir/ (N files)'.

Implement budget enforcement: measure with afspec.EstimateTokens. When the full map exceeds budget, reduce in order: (1) drop unexported declarations, (2) drop test-file declarations, (3) drop declarations from deepest directories first, (4) collapse deepest directories. Directories named in inputPaths or containing a file in inputPaths are reduced last at the same depth.
Ensure determinism: no maps iterated without sorting, no timestamps or sizes.
Run all tests and confirm they pass. Run make lint.
